key_insight: LumosX introduces explicit identity–attribute modeling and a face-attribute-aware data strategy to enforce consistent face-attribute alignment across multiple subjects and frames, improving precision in personalized text-to-video generation.
problem_solved: Current personalized video generation struggles to keep specified facial attributes (e.g., hairstyle, expression, accessories) consistently aligned across different subjects and frames because existing pipelines lack mechanisms and data tailored for intra-group face-attribute consistency.
method: Identity–Attribute Relational Module: explicitly links each subject identity to attribute embeddings so attributes can be consistently conditioned per identity during generation.
Face-Attribute-Aware Data Strategy: curate/annotate training data and sampling schemes that emphasize multi-subject, multi-attribute examples to teach intra-group consistency.

Consistency-Guided Diffusion Training: condition a diffusion-based video generator on identity–attribute signals and add face-attribute consistency and temporal regularization losses to preserve identity and attribute coherence across frames.
impact: Makes personalized video generation more reliable for applications requiring precise, repeatable control of facial attributes (avatars, virtual production, customized content), and provides a framework and data emphasis that can improve robustness and evaluation of identity-attribute fidelity.

paper_title: LumosX: Relate Any Identities with Their Attributes for Personalized Video Generation
paper_authors: Jiazheng Xing, Fei Du, Hangjie Yuan, Pengwei Liu, Hongbin Xu
